text: Carpentry is a skilled occupation that involves the art of constructing structures, furniture, and other building components. It requires precision, patience, and a deep understanding of various techniques, including joint construction. Carpenters use a range of tools, such as chisels, planes, and saws, to create precise joints and form the final structure. Varnish, an important finishing detail, is applied to the finished piece to enhance its appearance and protect it from the elements.
